limitations: This manifest is an additive triage record, not a SnapshotSpec or research-feed access control.
A checksum binds content; it is not a digital signature, broker authenticity proof, or acceptance approval.
Compressed bytes are verified freshly; semantic metrics are reconciled against recorded evidence without another raw tick scan.
Quarantine is recorded by partition identity; raw files are neither moved, edited, filtered, nor deleted.
All repeated source ticks remain preserved; exact adjacent duplicates alone are not a rejection rule.
Empty sessions remain unadjudicated; no closure, outage, or replacement observations are invented.
Coverage is limited to the planned sessions; it does not establish continuous historical availability.
